pb-newsletter.title: Newsletter service
pb-newsletter.intro: Write each issue, check the list, then send from your own tool.
pb-newsletter.consent: These people agreed to this newsletter.
pb-newsletter.csvHint: Use the list attached to this order. CSV columns: email,firstName.
pb-newsletter.mxPending: Mail servers have not been checked yet.
pb-newsletter.imported: Approved contacts imported. No email was sent.
pb-newsletter.permissionHold: Live client lists wait for a lawyer to confirm the consent rule. Prepare here and use your own tool manually meanwhile.
pb-newsletter.subject: Subject
pb-newsletter.planRemaining: Messages left in your tool plan
pb-newsletter.providerReady: I checked authentication and one-click unsubscribe in my tool.
pb-newsletter.setupHint: Your tool must add the correct unsubscribe headers. A visible link alone is not one-click unsubscribe.
pb-newsletter.sponsorLabel: The exported copy is labelled Sponsored.
pb-newsletter.unsent: Nothing is sent by Chausar. Review this issue and audience before exporting.
pb-newsletter.handoff: Copy into your own tool, review its preview, then send there.
pb-newsletter.fix.subject: Add an honest subject.
pb-newsletter.fix.merge-body: Resolve every recipient's body merge fields.
pb-newsletter.fix.unsubscribe: Use the actual HTTPS unsubscribe link, without template fields.
pb-newsletter.fix.size: Keep the rendered issue below 100 KB.
pb-newsletter.fix.postal: Add the actual postal address without template fields.
pb-newsletter.fix.sender: Use the From address allowed in your tool.
pb-newsletter.fix.plan: Check your tool's remaining message allowance.
pb-newsletter.fix.test: Send a test in your tool and record its UTC time.
pb-newsletter.fix.provider: Check authentication and unsubscribe setup in your tool.
pb-newsletter.fix.sponsor: Name the sponsor, label its copy Sponsored and remove template fields.
pb-newsletter.error.REQUEST_FAILED: This could not be completed. Try again.
pb-newsletter.error.APPROVAL_CHANGED: The issue, source or audience changed. Review it again.
pb-newsletter.error.NEWSLETTER_CONSENT_R: Confirm permission for this newsletter first.
pb-newsletter.error.RULE_UNCONFIRMED: A lawyer must confirm the applicable rule. Use your own tool manually meanwhile.
pb-newsletter.error.NEWSLETTER_INPUT_INV: Check the requested fields and source format.
pb-newsletter.error.NEWSLETTER_SOURCE_RE: Attach the CSV to this newsletter order.
pb-newsletter.error.DERIVED_STALE: The order or consent changed. Prepare a new issue.
pb-newsletter.error.NEWSLETTER_NOT_FOUND: Choose an issue or subscriber in this business.
pb-newsletter.error.NEWSLETTER_CHECK_FAI: Resolve the blocking checks before export.
pb-newsletter.error.NEWSLETTER_AUDIENCE_: No eligible subscribers remain for this message.
pb-newsletter.error.NEWSLETTER_RESULTS_R: Import matching results after three hours. A paused or blocked slice cannot continue.
pb-newsletter.error.NEWSLETTER_RESULTS_M: Use one result row for each exact exported recipient.
pb-newsletter.error.NEWSLETTER_EXPORTED: This issue already has an exported audience. Start a new issue to change its words.
pb-newsletter.error.OUTREACH_BLOCKED: An address is on the never-contact list. Refresh the audience.
pb-newsletter.error.INVALID_VENTURE_REQU: Use the requested action and fields.
pb-newsletter.sourceHelp: One fact per line. AI selects and orders your exact notes. You review meaning and may rewrite the draft. Private notes stay manual until a qualified local model is available.
pb-newsletter.resultsHelp: Attach your tool's recipient export to this order, then review it here. An export from Chausar is not proof of sending.
pb-newsletter.reportColumns: CSV columns: email,sentAt,reportedAt,status,opened,clicked,complained. Use complete UTC times; status delivered, bounced or unsubscribed; flags 0 or 1. One row per approved recipient. Optionally append openedAt,clickedAt with actual UTC event times; leave absent events empty.
pb-newsletter.opensSoft: Opens are a soft signal. Counts are from your tool export, not independent measurement.
pb-newsletter.comparisonReady: Comparison uses your own earlier issues, up to ten.
pb-newsletter.comparisonWait: A comparison needs two earlier issues for this same list.
pb-newsletter.hourlyUnknown: This recipient export has no hourly observations. Unobserved and future hours stay blank.
pb-newsletter.pricesHelp: Set your own rupee prices. This calculation does not bill, change a published price or predict sales.
pb-newsletter.cleanupHelp: After six ignored issues and 180 quiet days, ask once whether to stay. Only a reported last-chance send starts the 14-day wait. Cleanup never deletes anyone.
pb-newsletter.forgetHelp: Forget deletes this person's saved details and source copies, including affected issue and report copies. A one-way block prevents reimport. Earlier backups remain until deleted.
pb-newsletter.error.PRIVATE_NEEDS_LOCAL: Private notes need a qualified local model. Write manually meanwhile.
pb-newsletter.error.NO_MODEL_CONNECTED: Connect an AI in Your AI first.
pb-newsletter.error.NEWSLETTER_SOURCE_MI: The AI added unsupported wording. Review the source notes.
pb-newsletter.hourlyObserved: Only timestamped events from the tool export are shown. Blank hours are unobserved or in the future.
pb-newsletter.fix.tool: Use the actual tool name without template fields.
